rule_name: Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026; non-ferrous EPR may apply
section_ref: SWM Rules, 2026 rr. 1(1)-(2), 3(s), 5(1)(b), 5(2); HOTWM Rules, 2016 as amended 2025, Ch. VIII (conditional)
handler_requirement: authorized waste picker or collector per local-body directions; registered recycler when applicable
key_requirements: Segregate as dry waste and hand over to authorized waste pickers or collectors as directed by the local body (SWM Rules, 2026).

Human review is required until product and generator scope are known.
